recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球大小不均並有標靶細胞、鋸齒狀細胞與不規則碎片，可見兩個小而深染核的有核紅血球，部分紅血球內有細小深色點狀物（可能是嗜鹼性點彩或 Howell-Jolly 小體，解析度不足以確認），整體符合重型乙型地中海貧血。
features: Target cells, crenated/echinocytic cells, and irregular fragments
Two nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei
Fine dark punctate dots within some red cells, possibly basophilic stippling or small Howell-Jolly bodies (not resolvable here)
Numerous small platelets scattered in the background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with microcytes, target cells, crenated forms, and red cell fragments. Two nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei are seen. Some red cells contain fine dark punctate dots that may represent basophilic stippling or small Howell-Jolly bodies, but these cannot be characterized reliably at this resolution. Platelets are numerous. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major.

ddx.vs: Trait shows microcytosis and target cells with basophilic stippling but only mild poikilocytosis and no circulating NRBCs.
Lead toxicity gives coarse basophilic stippling in hypochromic cells but without target cells, fragments, or NRBCs.
Hb H disease shows golf-ball inclusions on supravital staining and typically fewer NRBCs.
